newsitem.title: USA: Wash. Water Pwr gets transmission to Calif..
newsitem.headline: Wash. Water Pwr gets transmission to Calif..

text.p: - Washington Water Power Co (WWP) announced Monday an agreement with Portland General Electric Co to acquire 100 to 200 megawatts (MW) of transmission access to the California/Oregon border.

Under terms of Portland General's published open access tariff, WWP will receive 100 MW of firm transmission capacity through the end of 1997 and a total 200 MW of firm capacity from January 1998 through the end of 2001.

"Like the joint marketing venture we entered into recently with one of California's leading natural gas marketers, Mock Energy Services, this agreement enhances our ability to provide a complete spectrum of integrated energy services to customers in California at competitive prices," said Lloyd Meyers, manager of WWP's energy marketing and trading.
